lines.text: Jehoshaphat visits Ahab in Samaria, and Ahab urges him to march up to Ramoth-gilead, and Jehoshaphat agrees to join the war.
Jehoshaphat asks Ahab to inquire first for the word of the LORD, so Ahab assembles four hundred prophets who say go up.
Zedekiah son of Chenaanah makes bronze horns and declares that with them Ahab will gore the Arameans.
Zedekiah strikes Micaiah in the face, and Ahab orders Micaiah put in prison and fed only bread and water.
Ahab disguises himself while Jehoshaphat wears royal robes, and when a stray arrow wounds Ahab, he dies at dawn.
